Bhel Puri 🥜🍅🍿
.
Ingredients:
• 1 medium onion (finely chopped)
• 1 medium tomato (finely chopped)
• 1-2 green chillies (finely chopped)
• A handful of crushed Lays chips (any flavor you like)
• A handful of Kurkure (any flavor)
• A handful of namkeens (like Haldiram’s bhujia/sev/farsan)
• A few roasted peanuts
• ½ tsp chaat masala (or to taste)
• Juice of ½ lemon (or to taste)
• Fresh coriander leaves (optional, chopped)
.
Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, add chopped onion, tomato, and green chillies.
2. Squeeze lemon juice and add chaat masala. Mix well.
3. Now add crushed Lays, Kurkure, namkeen, and peanuts.
4. Mix everything just before serving to keep it crunchy.
5. Taste and adjust lemon/chaat masala if needed.
6. Garnish with coriander (optional) and serve immediately.

Gajar Ka Halwa 🥕🥧

Ingredients:
• Carrots – 1 kg, grated
• Desi ghee (clarified butter) – 4–5 tablespoons
• Full-cream milk – 1 litre
• Sugar – ¾ to 1 cup (as per taste)
• Mawa / khoya – 150–200 g, crumbled
• Dry fruits:
• Cashews – chopped
• Almonds – chopped
• Pistachios – sliced
• Raisins
• Cardamom powder – ½ teaspoon

Method:
1. Heat ghee
Heat desi ghee in a heavy-bottomed kadhai or pan.
2. Add grated carrots
Add the grated carrots and sauté on medium heat until they become soft and shrink in volume (their moisture evaporates).
3. Add milk
Slowly pour in the milk while stirring.
Cook on medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the milk reduces and the mixture becomes thick and almost dry.
4. Add sugar
Add sugar and mix well.
The mixture will loosen at first—this is normal.
Continue cooking until it thickens again.
5. Add mawa (khoya)
Add the crumbled mawa and mix well.
Cook for 4–5 minutes until the halwa becomes rich and starts leaving the sides of the pan.
6. Add dry fruits and cardamom
Add cashews, almonds, pistachios, raisins, and cardamom powder.
Mix well and cook for another 2 minutes.
7. Serve
Serve hot.
You may add a little extra ghee on top for a richer taste.

Peri Peri Fries 🥔🍟
.
Ingredients:
• 3–4 medium potatoes
• Salt (as needed)
• Water (for boiling)
• Oil (for deep frying)
• 1 tsp peri peri masala (or chili powder + garlic powder + paprika mix)
• 2 tbsp mayonnaise
• 2 tbsp tomato ketchup

Instructions:
1. Prepare the potatoes:
• Peel and cut potatoes into thin fries (sticks).
• Wash them well in cold water to remove extra starch.
2. Boil:
• In a pot, add water and a little salt.
• Boil the potato sticks for 3–4 minutes (don’t overcook).
• Drain and pat dry completely with a cloth or tissue.
3. First fry:
• Heat oil on medium flame.
• Fry the potatoes for 3–4 minutes until slightly cooked but not golden.
• Remove and let them cool for 10–15 minutes.
4. Second fry (for crispiness):
• Reheat the oil on high flame.
• Fry the potatoes again until golden and crispy.
• Take them out on paper towels to remove excess oil.
5. Add flavor:
• While still hot, sprinkle peri peri masala evenly over the fries.
• Toss gently so all fries get coated.
6. Top it off:
• Drizzle mayonnaise and ketchup on top in layers or zig-zag pattern.

Donuts 🍩🍫

Ingredients:
• Bread slices – 6
• Milk – 2 to 3 tablespoons (use little by little)
• Powdered sugar – 3 tablespoons (adjust to taste)
• Oil – for deep frying
• Chocolate (dark or milk) – ½ cup
• Colorful sprinkles – 2 tablespoons

Method:
1. Cut and remove the brown edges of all bread slices.
2. Tear the bread into small pieces and place them in a bowl.
3. Add powdered sugar and mix well.
4. Slowly add milk (1 tablespoon at a time) and knead into a soft, smooth dough.
5. Take a small portion of the dough and roll it into a ball.
6. Flatten it slightly and make a hole in the center using a stick or your finger to shape a donut.
7. Heat oil on medium flame and deep fry the donuts until golden brown on both sides.
8. Remove and place on tissue paper to absorb excess oil.
9. Melt the chocolate using a double boiler (place chocolate in a bowl over boiling water).
10. Dip each donut into the melted chocolate.
11. Sprinkle colorful sprinkles on top while the chocolate is still warm.

Let the chocolate set for a few minutes, then serve.
